before.content:
await page.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Message" }).fill("echo hello")
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Send" }).click()
  await expect(page.getByText("Working")).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByRole("alertdialog")).toBeVisible()
  if (process.env.JI_STAGE1_EVIDENCE_DIR) {
    await page.screenshot({ path: `${process.env.JI_STAGE1_EVIDENCE_DIR}/real-host-permission.png`, fullPage: true })
  }

after.content:
await expect(permission).toContainText("echo")
  await expect(permission).toContainText("hello")
  await expect(permission).toContainText("Target workspace")
  await expect(permission).toContainText("Workspace policy requires approval for this operation.")
  await expect(permission.getByText("Medium", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  const permissionAxe = await new AxeBuilder({ page }).analyze()
  expect(permissionAxe.violations.filter(item => ["critical", "serious"].includes(item.impact ?? ""))).toEqual([])
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.closest('[role="alertdialog"]') !== null)).toBe(true)
  await page.emulateMedia({ forcedColors: "active" })
  await expect(permission.getByText("Medium", { exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(permission.getByRole("button", { name: "Deny" })).toBeVisible()
  await page.emulateMedia({ forcedColors: "none" })
  if (process.env.JI_STAGE1_EVIDENCE_DIR) {
    const viewport = process.env.JI_STAGE1_VIEWPORT ?? "desktop-wide"
    await page.screenshot({ path: `${process.env.JI_STAGE1_EVIDENCE_DIR}/${viewport}-real-host-permission.png`, fullPage: true })
  }
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Allow" }).click()
  await expect(page.getByLabel("echo tool completed")).toContainText("echoed hello")
